headline: Marathon Nextgen acquires remaining stake in Swayam Realtors
hook: Full control of Byculla luxury project
summary: Marathon Nextgen Realty has acquired an additional 60% stake in Swayam Realtors and Traders LLP, its joint venture entity. With this transaction, the company now holds the full economic interest in the Monte South residential project located in Byculla, Mumbai. The buyout consolidates the developer's ownership and future revenue share from the ongoing real estate project. Indian retail investors tracking real estate stocks should note this consolidation of project ownership.
why_it_matters: Marathon Nextgen consolidates full earnings from its Byculla project.
